name: vetted.tools
one_liner: Vetted's site, rebuilt from a blank Next.js app: a tool directory, AI use cases, and Vetty, a stop-motion mascot who hides in the footer.

name: The publish pipeline
one_liner: I built it so that saving a link is the whole workflow. A run every three hours picks up what is new and publishes it with a screenshot, and I can start a run myself when I do not want to wait.

name: AayushOS
one_liner: A markdown operating system I built to run my life out of. Agents read from it and write back to it.
